- Private/on-prem exception: acceptable but needs a deployment annex and procurement lead time; flag as "requires 60-90 day lead for Ops" in redline margin.

I'll prepare MSA_OrderForm_DPA_redline_v3.docx and SCCs_Mapping_Table_Novapath.xlsx and upload to the drive. Marissa — please draft the short exec note that ties the options to pricing/lead time so we can present clear tradeoffs.
